scope: Proposition 3.1 of the manuscript “Spectral scalar curvature and Urysohn width in dimension three” (preprints/Spectral-scalar-curvature-and-Urysohn-width-in-dimension-three-October-5-2026/spectral-urysohn-three-manifolds.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 336 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 2a0852ff04d11752), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 8. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There is a locally finite family S of pairwise disjoint closed connected embedded two-sided stable weighted minimal surfaces in M such that the following statements hold. Let N be the manifold obtained by cutting M along S, and let q : N → M be the natural gluing map. 1. The map q is proper and is a quotient map. Each connected component P of N, with the intrinsic length metric of the pulled-back metric g, is proper. 2. Each boundary component of P is a sphere or a real projective plane, is stable weighted minimal, and has intrinsic g-diameter at most 2π. Each surface of S gives two boundary copies in N. 3. Every compact connected neatly embedded two-sided hypersurface in P separates P.
